title: Bureau Price List for Repulled Tri-Merge Reports on a Mortgage Loan File
content:
**Price rule.** The per-borrower price of a credit report repull on a Mortgage Loan File depends on how recently the same file was last charged for a credit report:

- where the file's fee ledger carries a credit report fee charge booked less than 6 whole months before the pull date, the bureaus upgrade that existing Larkspur tri-merge and the per-borrower price is **61.80 USD**;
- where the file carries no such charge but carries one booked less than 12 whole months before the pull date, the per-borrower price is **78.40 USD**;
- where the file carries no credit report fee charge booked less than 12 whole months before the pull date, the per-borrower price is the program's credit report fee per borrower, as listed in the Larkspur program fee schedule.

Only credit report fee charges on the same loan file's fee ledger are read; the tiers are tested in the order above and the first that holds sets the price.

## Counting whole months

A charge's age in whole months is the number of calendar months from its booking date to the pull date, less one where the day of the month of the pull date is earlier than the day of the month of the booking date.

| Most recent credit report fee charge on the file | Pull date (hypothetical) | Whole months | Per-borrower price |
|---|---|---|---|
| booked 15 January | 14 July | 5 — less than 6 | 61.80 USD |
| booked 15 January | 15 July | 6 — not less than 6, but less than 12 | 78.40 USD |
| booked 15 January | 14 January of the next year | 11 — less than 12 | 78.40 USD |
| booked 15 January | 15 January of the next year | 12 — not less than 12 | the program's per-borrower credit report fee |
| no credit report fee charge on the file | any date | — | the program's per-borrower credit report fee |

## Basis questions

**Does a charge on another of the customer's loan files count?** No. The price looks only at the fee ledger of the file being repulled.

**Why the lower price for a recent charge?** Within 6 whole months the bureaus upgrade the existing Larkspur tri-merge rather than producing a new one.
